subject: Packaging decision: upgrade lanes, bundled feature mapping for Concord Health
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@concordhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <m.singh@concordhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging — upgrade lanes & feature bundling questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're trying to map out an upgrade path from our current Compact plan to something that supports higher throughput and better observability. A few specific asks from our side: 

- We expect a 3x token throughput increase over the next 6 months; want to understand Dedicated sizing vs a hybrid (reserved + hosted overflow).
- We care about "Observability" (trace + token-level cost breakdown) and "Prefix KV caching" as bundled features — is that a single add-on or two separate entitlements?
- How does proration work if we pilot for 6 weeks then commit to Dedicated for 12 months? Any standard concessions/credits?

I've attached our current usage breakdown (Concord_usage_Q2.xlsx) so you can see the distribution.

Can you and your pricing lead outline the recommended lanes (fast upgrade / staged pilot / hybrid) and the typical economics for each? We'd like something we can take to procurement next week.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Director of Platform Engineering
Concord Health

Attachment: Concord_usage_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@concordhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Packaging — upgrade lanes & feature bundling questions

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and upload. I reviewed the usage sheet and sketched three practical upgrade lanes below. Attaching our latest pricing matrix so you have concrete numbers.

1) Fast upgrade (Dedicated, 12mo commit)
   - Immediate capacity reservation; predictable latency SLA.
   - Bundled observability + KV caching can be included as a packaged addon (single SKU) at a 7% premium vs separate add-ons.
   - Proration: standard pro-rata on remaining Compact credit; onboarding credit (one-time) available for >=12mo commitments.

2) Staged pilot (6–8 week pilot on Dedicated pilot pool, then roll to full 12mo if successful)
   - Pilot billed at discounted pilot rate (applied as one-time credit against first full invoice if you convert).
   - Feature bundles can be toggled during pilot; if you add observability mid-pilot we'll pro-rate that add-on to conversion.

3) Hybrid (Reserved capacity for baseline, hosted overflow)
   - Lower committed cost; overflow hits hosted API at metered rates.
   - Good if you expect spiky bursts (3x average but only occasional peaks).

What I'd like from you: confirm which lane you want to see a formal quote for (fast / staged / hybrid) and confirm whether Observability + KV caching should be quoted as a combined addon or separately.

I've attached: redwood-pricing-matrix-v3.pdf (pricing bands + sample TCO scenarios). Looping in Ben for discounting and Lauren for contractual/rollout terms.

Thanks — I can get a formal quote within 24 hours once you confirm.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Tel: +1 415 555 0124
Attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix-v3.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@concordhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Packaging — upgrade lanes & feature bundling questions

Jordan — quick note from pricing: glad to see Concord is looking at a staged approach; we can support that with a standard commercial concession. Key points: 

- If you convert from the 6–8 week pilot to a 12-month Dedicated commit within 30 days of pilot close, we can apply a 10% TCV discount on the first-year commitment.
- We will also offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to up to 1 month of Compact spend (to offset migration/testing).
- Seat-to-feature crediting: if you already have prepaid Compact credits, we'll convert / apply leftover credits at the same unit price toward Reserved capacity for the first billing cycle.

Operational asks: please confirm expected peak tokens/sec and average daily tokens — I used an estimate of peak 8k tokens/sec from the sheet but want the confirmed numbers to size Dedicated capacity and the discount banding.

I can prepare a formal quote (SOW + commercial terms) once you confirm lane and throughput numbers. If you want to push this to procurement quickly we can also pre-populate a DocuSign with the pilot-to-commit clause.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 617 555 0891

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@concordhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <m.singh@concordhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging — upgrade lanes & feature bundling questions

Thanks — this is helpful. We discussed internally and want to proceed with the staged pilot lane. A couple quick confirmations before you generate the formal quote: 

- Pilot duration: 6 weeks with the option to convert; we expect to convert to a 12mo Dedicated commit if the pilot meets latency and cost targets.
- Bundle: Please quote Observability + KV caching as a combined addon SKU (we prefer the single-bill path).
- Throughput: confirmed peak ~7,500 tokens/sec; average ~1,800 tokens/day (spread across several microservices).

Attachment: Concord_feature_matrix.xlsx — outlines which teams need the observability dashboards vs token-level billing.

Next steps: Please send a formal quote + DocuSign pilot-to-commit addendum and propose a kickoff call for Monday at 10am PT.
